author: claude:97b8de73
text:
Phase 2 Research: Sub-block precision

Current state:
- resolveMouseTarget() already computes blockIndex from relative Y within card
- Click handler navigates to child nodes using getVisibleDescendantIds()
- Sub-block targeting works via fixed 1-row-per-child assumption

What would improve it:
- Register child positions in navigator for pixel-perfect hit testing
- Current 1-row-per-child breaks for wrapped titles or variable-height children
- TreeNode would need useScreenRectCallback for each child
- Perf concern: N children * M cards * K columns = many registrations
- Alternative: use card bounding box + relative Y (current approach) but account for variable row heights by reading actual rendered content dimensions

author: claude:8f007ba9
text: Root cause: evaluateAddRule and getEmbedTargetsOnBoard only checked type='link' embed nodes when deduplicating. Markdown-parsed embeds are stored as 'oi' nodes with link_to set, so they were invisible to the dedup checks. Fix: (1) broadened getEmbedTargetsOnBoard SQL to match any node with link_to IS NOT NULL, (2) broadened within-section existingEmbeds check to include any node with link_to, (3) added dedup in nodes2md serializeChildren to skip duplicate embed targets during serialization. Test added to db-rules.test.ts confirming the fix.
